description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the UtilGenerics utility class in the ofbiz framework, focusing on collection type-checking methods.

classes.name: UtilGenericsTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for methods in UtilGenerics, verifying collection checks and type safety.
